subject: Communication Systems
questionText:
Assume that the error occurs only between adjacent 
points. What is the additional transmitted power 
required in the right phased signal to achieve in same 
error probability as the four phased signal at high 
SNR?  
 
(a) 
3.41 dB 
(b) 3.5 dB 
 
(c) 
4.31 dB 
(d) 5.3 dB
explanation: Practice Question from Communication Systems DPP-06 (PRACTICE SHEET 01).
